answer:
You should use **`VectorStoreIndex`**. The docs show the simplest way to build one from your documents: "The simplest way to use a Vector Store is to load a set of documents and build an index from them using `from_documents`:" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/indexing/vector_store_index.md]

The example code is:

"index = VectorStoreIndex.from_documents(documents)" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/rag/indexing/index.md]

Here `documents` is the list you get from a loader such as `SimpleDirectoryReader(...).load_data()`. If you already have `Node` objects, the docs also say you can "build an index over a list of Node objects directly" with `VectorStoreIndex(nodes)` [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/rag/indexing/index.md].
